name: Ambient CrocSwapDex surplus-collateral accounting
summary: Flash-loaned WETH deposited as CrocSwapDex native surplus collateral, then a tick-by-tick walk of the ETH/USDC curve with a narrow mint-and-harvest let the attacker disburse more surplus than was deposited, exposing a surplus-collateral accounting flaw in the dex.
notes: The final pre-incident callpath-1 sidecar-install event selected WarmPath 0xa9dd587ad17aed82cac5596b16dcc9defec885cb; event data identifies callpath 1.

After the 50 WETH Balancer flash loan was repaid, the receipt records 33.721988711712491517 WETH and 55,913.808223 USDC leaving the attack helper as proceeds. The downstream USDC-to-WETH conversion and builder payments are excluded to avoid double counting.
